Contract scope

What goes into your agreement?

A home with two split AC units needs a different checklist from a warehouse with a cold room. Your written proposal names the assets, the work on each visit and the contact who can approve repairs.

Plan for your propertyHomes & villasOffices & retailWarehouses
Scheduled maintenance
List the cooling equipment, drains, fixtures and electrical points you want checked. Agree access, the work window and what the technician records after each visit.
Breakdowns, labour and parts
Agree the call-out allowance, attendance hours and labour limits. The proposal should identify which materials are covered and who approves a replacement or extra visit.
Specialist equipment
For cold rooms, pumps or multi-site plant, share the model, location and operating hours. These assets need a written scope and may carry a separate price.

Build your AMC proposal

Choose the visit calendar and payment schedule separately. For example, you can request quarterly visits and pay yearly. The written proposal confirms both.
